context_requirements: Functional BMP/TGF-beta receptor signaling (ACVR1, BMPR1A) and intact SMAD1/5/8-SMAD4 transduction
Mesenchymal or epithelial lineage with active BMP-driven differentiation or inflammatory programs
No dominant loss-of-function mutation in BMP pathway components
falsifiers: No change in ID2, SMAD3, or BAMBI at 6 h in any line
No reduction in proliferation markers (MYC, CCND1, MKI67) at 24 h
No induction of SPP1, COL1A1, or MMP1 at 24 h
Uniform strong response across all nine lines including non-BMP-responsive lines

evidence.supports: BMP inhibition by noggin reduces vascular inflammation and inflammatory gene transcription in vivo
Tob acts as a BMP inhibitor and suppresses proliferation, linking BMP inhibition to antiproliferative effects

changes: Removed TGFB3 from proximal_up because BMP inhibition does not directly induce TGFB3 transcription; it remains only in late_up.
Removed TGFBR2 from proximal_up because BMP inhibition does not directly induce this receptor.
Removed duplicate TGFB3 from proximal_down; a gene cannot appear in both up and down lists at the same time.
Removed MMP2 from late_down because it is already listed in late_up and cannot be both up and down at 24 h.
Removed PMID 37898061 from evidence because its abstract does not directly support the stated claim about BMP inhibition modulating osteoblast marker genes and mineralization.
